model_result.answer_summary: Option (b): n is odd. The depicted inventories contain n + 17 open attachment ends, and a complete assembly pairs them into bonds, so n + 17 is even and n is odd. Connected acyclicity further gives n = 1.
assumptions: Problem-page input: fragments a, b, c, and d have respectively 1, 2, 3, and 1 open attachment ends per copy, with multiplicities n, 2, 3, and 4.
Problem-page input: the supplied fragments form the non-ionised PL1 molecule; consequently every depicted open attachment end is used.
Trusted general bonding rule: every joining bond pairs exactly two open attachment ends.
Only for the stronger n = 1 theorem: PL1 is one connected acyclic molecule, so joining V initially separate connected fragments uses V - 1 bonds.
